query_original: What is the minimum mass of an F1 car during Qualifying and Sprint Qualifying sessions in the 2026 Technical Regulations?
query_reformulada: What is the minimum vehicle weight for a Formula One car during qualifying and sprint qualifying sessions as per Article 28.3 of the 2026 FIA Formula One World Championship technical regulations?
resposta: The minimum mass of an F1 car during Qualifying and Sprint Qualifying sessions in the 2026 Technical Regulations is 726kg plus the Nominal Tyre Mass.
